name: Eleven Players and a Planet: The Story of the World Cup
description: From thirteen teams in Montevideo to a worldwide festival: the football World Cup through upsets, heroes and heartbreak.

checkpoints.name: The early cups
checkpoints.note: A small tournament in Uruguay turns into a global event. Home teams win, Brazil is stunned at the Maracana, and Germany shocks Hungary in Bern.

checkpoints.name: The age of Pele
checkpoints.note: Television brings the Cup into homes across the world. Brazil wins three times, England wins once at Wembley, and the Dutch bring a new style of play.

checkpoints.name: Stars and money
checkpoints.note: Maradona leads Argentina to glory, and the tournament moves to Italy and then the United States, where it becomes a giant business.

checkpoints.name: A global game
checkpoints.note: The Cup goes to Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Spain, Germany and Argentina win, and the final of 2022 is decided on penalties after an extraordinary match.
